name: Have the world by the tail

meaning.zh:
“拥有全世界” 或 “掌控一切”。

这个短语起源于 20 世纪早期的美国，常用于描述一个人处于极其有利和具掌控的位置。在这种情况下，个人感觉自己能够掌握或控制自己的生活和周围的各种事物，如同抓住了世界的尾巴一样。
meaning.en: This phrase originated in early 20th-century America and is used to describe a person who is in a very advantageous and controlling position. In such a scenario, the individual feels they can manage their life and surroundings, as if they have grabbed the world by the tail.

lines.en: After landing his dream job, he felt like he had the world by the tail.
lines.zh: 在得到梦寐以求的工作后，他感觉自己掌控了一切。

lines.en: With her talents and opportunities, she truly has the world by the tail.
lines.zh: 凭借她的才华和机会，她确实掌控了一切。

lines.en: Starting his own business made him feel like he had the world by the tail.
lines.zh: 创办自己的公司让他觉得自己掌控了一切。
